title: The Sealed Immortal
summary: At a fragment continent, Shengong Hu and Zhan Konglie watch a huge new formation open far too fast, and a white-haired old man breaks out of it, crying that he has returned and is reborn. On the way to the Immortal Gate, Wang Lin and Li Yuan are attacked by a severed arm close to Nirvana Scryer in power that swallows thunder; Wang Lin uses the Third Eye to survive what he calls his most dangerous fight since reaching Corporeal Yang, and guesses that a great expert is reassembling his body through slaughter. The old man curses Qing Shui, who he says cut his body apart and sealed it, a seal that saved him from the destruction of the Celestial Realm, and he sets out to devour the cultivators in the realm. At the gate he seals the Immortal Gate so no one can leave; the Zhan, Tang, Sun, Lu and Zheng families charge him together and he crushes them with the immortal True Form art. Instead of hiding, Wang Lin asks Li Yuan to trust him and uses the Earthfold Step to merge fully with heaven and earth and vanish, an escape art the old man admits few ancient immortals mastered, but the old man finds him anyway.
events: The white-haired old man breaks out of a sealed formation
